tsp_name: TRANSCONTINENTAL GAS PIPE LINE COMPANY, LLC
notes: Values RAW Dth/d, never converted. Both legs of bidirectional meters are separate series (flow r|d|u). Watchlist-scoped: Transco publishes ~541 locations per cycle; wholesale emission would balloon the parquet (TETCO lesson).

high.label: sabine_pass_lng
high.evidence: Transco Zone 3 interconnect deliveries to Sabine Pass Liquefaction; Cheniere publishes no scheduled quantities, so this is the measured feedgas proxy. Name rule avoids the TETCO 'CHENIERE LNG, BEAUREGARD PA' false-positive class.

high.label: golden_pass_lng
high.evidence: Golden Pass supply moves over the Texas/Southern Gas lateral corridor into Transco Zone 3; pipeline-side points complement the gasnom terminal-side meter.

high.label: cove_point_lng
high.evidence: Cove Point supply enters via Transco Zone 6 (Mid-Atlantic); EGTS Loudoun meters only one leg. If Zone 6 shows hundreds of MMcf/d against the current ~149 reading, the single-meter figure understates feedgas.

high.label: eminence_storage
high.evidence: Zone 2 salt-cavern storage pair; named in Transco's own OAC correction notices ('storage quantities for Eminence and Washington').

high.label: washington_storage
high.evidence: Zone 2 storage field, same OAC correction notice as Eminence. Requires STORAGE suffix so unrelated 'Washington' delivery points never match.

high.label: leidy_storage_complex
high.evidence: Zone 6 Leidy storage/line complex anchors Appalachia egress and Cove Point-era market flows.

candidate.label: transco_lng_peakshaving
candidate.evidence: Transco operates its own small LNG peakshaving facilities; distinct from export terminals. Kept as candidate until volumes confirm identity.

candidate.label: perryville_egress
candidate.evidence: Perryville hub exit on Zone 3 — Haynesville basin-egress anchor (RBN/CenterPoint documented hub).

candidate.label: station30_basin_proxy
candidate.evidence: Station 30 mainline proxy for South Texas supply entering Zone 1/2.

excluded_patterns_note: Do NOT regex bare 'LNG' — TETCO taught that 'Kinder Morgan LNG Receipt (WLA)' and similar are not terminal feedgas. Every LNG rule above requires the terminal name itself.
